state.source: docs/proposed/contexts/platform-access.md PA-27 and Member/PrimaryOrgAdmins tables. PrimaryOrgAdmins owns max two seats including pending; pending cannot count as remaining completed primary. Member owns mark versus suspend/deprovision ordering. Cross-owner negative outcome is an explicit business reservation response, not a generic failed command. Names below are the approved catalog names.

facts.name: PrimaryOrgAdminDesignationRequested
facts.completed_meaning: The tenant primary seat owner durably reserved one of maximum two seats pending this exact member episode response.

facts.name: PrimaryOrgAdminDesignated
facts.completed_meaning: The seat owner recorded that this member episode accepted the primary mark, completing its designation.

facts.name: PrimaryOrgAdminDesignationRefused
facts.completed_meaning: The seat owner recorded the exact member outcome refusing a pending designation and freed its seat.

facts.name: PrimaryOrgAdminReleased
facts.completed_meaning: The seat owner released a completed primary after verifying another fully designated primary remains.

facts.name: MemberMarkedPrimary
facts.completed_meaning: The member owner accepted the protective primary mark on its current active non-guest episode.

facts.name: MemberPrimaryMarkRefused
facts.completed_meaning: The member owner recorded that it cannot accept this pending designation because its episode is inactive or guest.

facts.name: MemberPrimaryMarkRemoved
facts.completed_meaning: The member owner removed its exact protective designation mark in response to the committed seat release.
